subject: maths
question: If P is 220% of Q, then what percentage of P + Q will Q be?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

According to question,

P = Q x 220/100

⇒ P/Q = 11/5

Required percentage = (5 times 100)/(11 +5) = 31.25%

**∴ Required percentage is 31.25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

P is 220% of Q

**Calculation:**

According to question,

P = Q x 220/100

⇒ P/Q = 11/5

Let P = 11

⇒ Q = 5

then P + Q = 11 + 5 = 16

Required percentage = (5 times 100)/(16) 

⇒ 31.25%

∴ Required percentage is 31.25%.
